messages:
anna: Heads-up — Legal opened a data subject deletion request that includes embeddings. They want an evidence hold for 30 days while they verify. ticket: INC-4192
maria-legal: Thanks, adding legal-hold. Need to confirm scope: include logs, embeddings, S3 snapshots? @kevin please advise on KMS-backed snapshots.
kevin: @maria-legal we should preserve S3 objects with Object Lock (governance mode) and add a retention-exemption tag for tracking. For embeddings in DB we need a soft-delete + immutable export. :thinking: 
anna: Also we need an RBAC change — temporary read access for forensics to the embeddings index. Proposal: create 'forensics_temp' role with read-only until 2026-01-12. Who can approve? @sahil
sahil: I can approve the RBAC change. Please file a PR to iam with TTL and include an audit log hook. :thumbsup:
eli: We must ensure Key Access Logs are captured. KMS policy should allow decrypt for the forensics role only when request tag 'evidence_hold=true' is present. cc @deploy-bot to apply policy.
deploy-bot: Scheduled job queued: apply-kms-policy (job id: apply-789). ETA ~15m.
kevin: For audit pipeline — route KMS and DB access logs to the secure-audit bucket and set 90d retention there. Also enable detailed IAM auth logs in CloudTrail. Example retention-exception API payload (internal):
```
POST /internal/retention-exceptions
{
  "ticket": "INC-4192",
  "scope": "embeddings,snapshots,access_logs",
  "hold_ttl": "30d",
  "approval": "sahil"
}
```
maria-legal: Perfect. Legal will sign off once we confirm export and lock applied.
anna: Security note: found CVE-2025-1234 in the vector-store client used by the index — patched in 2.4.1. We need to patch and restart index pods after export. @kevin can you coordinate with eng-runtime?
kevin: On it. Will schedule rolling restart after snapshot export completes. ETA ~2h. :hourglass:
sahil: Post-action requirement: ensure audit logs contain these fields: actor, action, resource, ticket, hold_tag. If any are missing we will pause offboarding/delete flows. :eyes:
eli: Quick checklist I'm adding to the ticket:
- create forensics_temp role (ttl + approval)
- apply KMS condition (evidence_hold tag)
- export embeddings snapshot (immutable copy)
- enable Object Lock on S3 snapshots
- route logs to secure-audit bucket
- call retention-exception API with ticket
- patch vector-store client to 2.4.1
- rolling restart of index pods
I'll push this checklist to INC-4192 in 10m.
maria-legal: Thanks all. Keep updates here. If the hold exceeds 48h escalate to GC.
anna: Noted. tagging @sahil @kevin @eli for follow-ups :lock:
